entries.115c81b41cd03f78: A company that develops, sells and installs medical information systems such as electronic medical record systems for medical institutions, and provides maintenance services.
entries.84de044c5b6ede69: Medical institutions, which are users of medical information systems
entries.8f54ddbb5adba7e2: This segment develops and sells medical information systems, including ordering systems and electronic medical record systems, and introduces them to medical institutions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥11,845 million.
entries.92c87a8d751452d9: This is the single-segment business conducted by the group consisting of the company and two subsidiaries. It develops and sells medical information systems, including ordering systems and electronic medical record systems, through to their implementation, and also provides maintenance services to users of these systems and sells hardware such as servers required for implementation. The consolidated subsidiary is SS-Net Co., Ltd., which plans, designs, installs, constructs, operates and maintains information equipment, among other activities. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥42,298 million.
entries.951569dd33b8b83b: This segment consists of products and services other than software, hardware and maintenance services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥1,240 million.
entries.95ccaa5783e4fa57: This segment provides maintenance services using online networks to users who have introduced medical information systems. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥10,083 million.
entries.fa9c80eea8f2f211: This segment sells hardware, such as servers, required for the introduction of medical information systems. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥19,129 million, the largest of the product and service categories.
